name: Trade contractor journey
description: How a remodeling contractor moves from a failed finish on a competitor's doors to a standing order with Brightside.

stages.name: Unaware
stages.description: Blames the homeowner's cleaning products for a lifted finish.
opportunities: name the call-back in his words

stages.name: Problem Aware
stages.description: Knows the finish schedule is where doors fail; does not know what a good one looks like.
pain_points: a finish that lifts inside a year and lands on his invoice
touchpoints: a shop blog a client forwards
opportunities: show the failure mechanism: no key between coats

stages.name: Solution Aware
stages.description: Comparing shops on their finish room, not their showroom.
pain_points: every shop claims the same schedule
opportunities: give him the questions to ask any shop

stages.name: Product Aware
stages.description: Knows Brightside's schedule; wants proof it holds on a real job.
pain_points: a trial job that goes wrong is his name on it
opportunities: the 18-month check on a named job

stages.name: Most Aware
stages.description: Has a standing order; wants the next job to be as boring as the last.
pain_points: a schedule change he hears about late

checkpoints.metric: blog sessions from the finish-durability cluster
